# Family Portraits

Family portraits: one portrait of your family from photos in your MegaScenes library, everyone with their own face, in the style and setting you choose, from studio to painted.

## What it does
Pick photos of your family from your MegaScenes library and choose the style, the setting and the outfits. Claude tells you the price and puts everyone together in one picture.

**How the files are made:** each family portrait is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Only people who agreed to it, never famous people.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install family-portraits@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Family Portraits talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/family-portrait/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each family portrait uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The family portraits show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_family_portrait_models` | Models for family portraits with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_family_portrait_cost` | Exact price of one family portrait before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_family_portrait` | Starts one family portrait in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_family_portrait` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the ones to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make a family portrait from my latest MegaScenes photos"
- "Turn our family photos into a classic studio portrait"
- "Create a painted holiday portrait of my family"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the family portrait (the photos you pick from your library and the style, setting and outfits) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
